messages:
maria: Heads-up — we’re opening a small L12e micro-pool in ap-northeast-3 (Osaka) and sa-east-1 (Santiago) for dedicated customers starting today. Soft launch, limited slots.
ops-bot: Deployment: l12e-micropool-osaka scheduled at 2025-09-14T14:00Z — healthchecks passed :white_check_mark:
maria: Notes: these are non-preemptible, single-tenant nodes (2x L12e / host). Expected steady-state qps per node ~ 600 tokens/s for our standard T5-like workloads.
engops: Reservation policy update — to keep access balanced during the soft launch we’re capping new single-org reservations to 6 hosts total across both regions. API: tag reservations with `pool:l12e-soft`.
marcus: Pricing: per-node monthly commit and on-demand burst rates will be posted in the pricing doc. Short answer: on-demand is ~1.6x our A100 baseline.
tina: Is there a fallback model if L12e capacity runs out? We should mention routing behavior in the console message.
maria: Yes — smart routing will fall back to L6e (latency-optimized) or L10e (cost-optimized) depending on your policy. If you pin model+pool, you’ll get queueing or failure instead — consider canary policies.
ryan: Operational limits: autoscale max replicas default = 4 per reservation during soft launch. To request higher, open a support ticket with expected qps and use-case.
emily: Quick how-to for SRE: set route policy `availability:prefer-l12e, fallback:l6e` in the config. Example:

```
route:
  name: inference-main
  policy: prefer-l12e
  fallback: l6e
```

maria: We’ll monitor tail latency and kernel OOMs closely this week. If you see sustained errors, file to #eng-runtime and tag `l12e-soft`.
engops: Ops note: no SOC-level compliance changes for this launch. KMS and VPC controls unchanged.
marcus: Can we get a short blurb for customer-facing status page? I’ll draft after we collect first-day metrics.
tina: Will the shared reserved buckets be affected? Asking because some teams depend on rotation windows.
engops: Rotation windows for reserved buckets are unchanged. Micro-pools are isolated and will not impact rotation. Only org-level reservation caps apply during soft launch.
maria: TL;DR: L12e micro-pools live in Osaka and Santiago, soft-cap reservations, smart-fallback in place. Please test and report perf regressions to #eng-ml. :rocket:
